startScreen.title: Situationship
description: A safe space to discuss the undefined.
No pressure to label, just space to understand.
Be honest about the vibe, the boundaries, and the undefined.

endScreen.title: Clarity Found
endScreen.subtitle: Whatever we are, thank you for being real

expectations.name: Expectations
expectations.description: What we actually want right now

questions.question: What was your first impression of our 'energy', and how has it changed since?
What’s one thing we do together that makes you feel most 'in the moment'?
How would you describe the 'vibe' between us to a stranger without using relationship labels?
What’s a boundary you have that you haven’t mentioned because we aren't 'official'?
On a scale of 1-10, how much of your real self do you hide to keep things 'chill'?
Is there something you want to ask me but feel like you don't have the 'right' to ask?
Does it bother you if I talk about other potential dates, or do we have an unspoken 'don't ask don't tell' rule?
If you woke up tomorrow and wanted more (or less) from this, would you feel safe telling me immediately?
What’s your 'green flag' and 'red flag' for how a situationship should end?
If we were to stop seeing each other tomorrow, would we stay friends or become strangers?
What’s one thing about your life outside of 'us' that I know absolutely nothing about?
In this moment, what are you most afraid of losing if we defined what we are?
